The '''Velusian fursnake''', or simply '''fursnake''', was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Snake/Legends|snake]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Volcano|volcanic]] islands of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]]. The snake had a large triangular [[Limb/Legends|head]] with many [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and a [[Bone/Legends|bony]] stinger on its tail, measuring two [[Meter/Legends|meter]]s long. While its bite was non-venomous, its stinger stored [[Poison/Legends|venom]] and could inject it. The reptile had [[Hair/Legends|fur]] to help maintain its internal [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]] that could be [[Color|black]] or tan-brown. The fursnake [[Diet/Legends|preyed]] on various [[Bird/Legends|avians]] that called the planet's islands home.<ref name="Core" /> 

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Khlor]] kept a pet fursnake named [[Sting (Velusian fursnake)|Sting]] that was always curled around his neck and shoulders. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter also kept four vials of Velusian fursnake venom on his person.<ref name="Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velusian fursnakes were mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" />
